ja: • メガリザードンXがポケプラで登場。
• しっぽを上げて威嚇、上空を見上げて咆哮。カッコイイポーズで遊びつくそう。
• 付属の台座で大空を飛行するポーズも可能。
成形品×3、ホイルシール×1、組立説明書×1
en: • Mega Charizard X is now available on PokePla.
• Raise its tail to threaten, look up at the sky and roar. He seems to be having fun with all the cool poses.
• You can also pose him flying in the sky with the included pedestal.
Molded product x 3, foil seal x 1, assembly manual x 1
